mapper.sql: slot_code, usable_height, fork_height, destination_x, destination_y, destination_heading, status, reserved_task_id, stored_cargo_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO storage_slot (slot_code, usable_height, fork_height, destination_x, destination_y, destination_heading, status, reserved_task_id, stored_cargo_id) VALUES (#{slotCode}, #{usableHeight}, #{forkHeight}, #{destinationX}, #{destinationY}, #{destinationHeading}, #{status}, #{reservedTaskId}, #{storedCargoId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM storage_slot WHERE status = 'EMPTY' ORDER BY slot_code
mapper.update: UPDATE storage_slot SET status = 'RESERVED', reserved_task_id = #{reservedTaskId}, stored_cargo_id = NULL WHERE slot_code = #{slotCode} AND status = 'EMPTY'
UPDATE storage_slot SET status = 'OCCUPIED', stored_cargo_id = #{storedCargoId}, reserved_task_id = NULL WHERE slot_code = #{slotCode} AND status = 'RESERVED'
UPDATE storage_slot SET status = 'EMPTY', reserved_task_id = NULL, stored_cargo_id = NULL WHERE slot_code = #{slotCode} AND status = 'RESERVED'
